text:
olivia: Heads-up — starting canary deploy of inference-service v3.4.1 to prod in 10m. Routing 5% traffic to the new model variant. Deploy bot will post status. If p95 latency > 250ms or error rate > 2% we should execute backout. Acknowledge please.

marcus: Ack. I'll watch traces and the per-route dashboard. Can we confirm the pin/unpin playbook?

olivia: Pin/unpin doc is the same playbook as last quarter. Quick summary below.

anjali: Copying the short runbook I used yesterday:
- If full-service outage: immediate backout -> pin traffic to v3.3.9 (current stable), scale new pods down, disable autoscaler for the canary pool.
- If quality regression only (higher hallucinations / incorrect logits): consider rollforward with a hotfix model (v3.4.1-hotfix) or route partial traffic to fallback small model and monitor eval suite.
- DB/feature-flag changes: ensure feature flag rollback before unpin.

marcus: Paste of commands I keep handy:
```
# pin stable
redwoodctl route set inference-service --version v3.3.9 --percent 100
# disable canary autoscale
redwoodctl pools update canary-pool --min 0 --max 0
# emergency unpin (if deploy-bot pin failed)
redwoodctl route emergency-unpin inference-service --version v3.3.9
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: inference-service v3.4.1 canary 5% -> 1962345688

kai: Two quick clarifications: 1) Metrics alerts are already on (latency/error), 2) SLO fallback policy will route traffic to regional fallback if latency hits threshold for 30s. Do we want to shorten that window?

olivia: Good call. Shorten to 15s for this canary window. I'll update the alert.

anjali: Also note: KV-cache warmup can spike p95 for ~45s on first traffic. Use the warmup probe (runs first 10 warmup requests) before we evaluate. If spike only during warmup, hold 3m then reassess.

marcus: If we need to backout, who executes? Ops on-call (kai) executes routing pin and I handle infra (scaling). Olivia coordinates comms.

kai: Affirmative. If I see steady >15s latency window I'll start the backout steps and post status.

olivia: Rollforward path: if root cause is a quick tunable (batch size, kernel flag), we can push v3.4.1+patch and route 20% to patch for testing, then promote. Only do this if error rates are low.

deploy-bot: canary health: 5% -> healthy signals passing; p95 210ms; error rate 0.8% -> 1962345745

marcus: Noting checklist for post-backout RCA: collection of traces, mem/cpu dumps, kernel logs, and model logits for the offending requests. Tagging ticket infra-678.

olivia: Thanks — everyone stay on this thread for the next 20m. If we need to perform emergency unpin, call it out with "BACKOUT NOW" and include a short reason. :warning:

anjali: ACK. I have the backout runbook bookmarked and will paste full link if we need to run it. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary complete: 5% sustained for 12m, promoting to 25% per rollout policy -> 1962345850

kai: Watching 25% window now. No regressions so far.

marcus: All good from tracing side. Closing monitoring loop unless we see drift.

olivia: Closing thread in 10m if stable. Great rollout team work. :tada:
